summary: Real intimacy gets easier when you stop treating the subjects that matter most like the subjects most likely to ruin everything.
body: Real intimacy gets easier when you stop treating the subjects that matter most like the subjects most likely to ruin everything. When Venus trines Pluto, closeness can hold more honesty around money, loyalty, fear, intimacy, ownership, and power without every difficult conversation becoming evidence that the bond is in danger. You do not have to manufacture intensity or force somebody to reveal more than they are ready to share. Let the important truth exist in the relationship openly and notice how much energy returns once neither person has to keep working around it.
